versions.changelog:
litigation-risk-monitor v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a comprehensive workflow to monitor patent litigation risk for specified assignees, including INPADOC family analysis and web cross-verification.
- Automatically gathers and analyzes litigated patents, family members, legal status, regional/technical distribution, and case details.
- Provides deep-dive analysis of litigation cases (timeline, parties, processes, outcomes, focal disputes) and core inventor trends from the past 3 years.
- Generates a single HTML report (with embedded data and images) plus structured JSON/CSV attachments, outputting three-dimensional risk conclusions: regional risk, defense alerts, and trend forecasting.
- Strictly enforces "target-centric" report structure and wording for clarity and compliance.
